proposal.summary: Report describes a Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in wkhtmltopdf 0.12.6 where crafted HTML (an iframe pointing to an internal IP) sent to a /PDF/FromHTML endpoint causes the server-side renderer to fetch attacker-specified URLs.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Attempt to reproduce the SSRF by sending crafted HTML to the /PDF/FromHTML endpoint against a test instance of wkhtmltopdf 0.12.6 and capture outgoing requests; if confirmed, block external/internal URL fetching or add allowlist and sanitize input.

evidence_quotes.claim: HTTP request used to invoke the vulnerable endpoint
Exploit supplies HTML containing an iframe pointing to internal IP
